category_title: Reluctant communicators who avoid using communication aids and struggle to make choices
student_description: Lily is a student with limited verbal output who actively resists using traditional communication aids (like books or signing) and struggles with open-ended questions. She uniquely needs highly structured binary choices and thrives when allowed to participate through physical acting, miming, and sensory engagement (such as using costumes) rather than verbal or signed communication.

criteria.rationale: Lily struggles with open-ended questions and direct demands for ideas, but successfully engages when given exactly two structured options.
criteria.check: The tutor frames decisions or prompts as a choice between exactly two specific options, completely avoiding open-ended questions.

criteria.rationale: Lily is reluctant to use traditional communication aids but thrives when allowed to express herself through acting, miming, or using props and costumes.
criteria.check: The tutor offers opportunities for Lily to participate through physical action, miming, or using props/costumes, without demanding verbal output or the use of a communication book/signing.

criteria.rationale: Because Lily has limited verbal output, narrating the story for her allows her to take on roles through mime without the pressure of speaking lines.
criteria.check: The tutor provides the narrative or speaks the dialogue so that Lily is free to focus entirely on acting or miming her part.
